sql: SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) AS dt, MIN(dt) AS sort_dt, COUNT( id ) AS v1, COUNT( DISTINCT ip ) AS v2, CASE WHEN dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp} THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END AS period FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE (((dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) OR (dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}))) GROUP BY period, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) WITH ROLLUP
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN (searchterms IS NOT NULL) THEN id END) AS searches, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS ips FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE dt BETWEEN '{timestamp}' AND '{timestamp}' AND (1=1)
SELECT COUNT(id) as counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE (dt > {timestamp})
SELECT COUNT(id) as counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE (dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp})
SELECT ip, COUNT(*) AS counthits, MAX(dt) AS dt FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE ((dt_out > {timestamp}) OR (dt > {timestamp})) GROUP BY ip ORDER BY MAX(dt) DESC, ip ASC LIMIT 200
SELECT MAX(dt) FROM {prefix}slim_stats

SELECT resource, COUNT(*) AS counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE dt BETWEEN '{timestamp}' AND '{timestamp}' AND ((1=1) AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) GROUP BY resource ORDER BY counthits DESC, resource ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT REPLACE( SUBSTRING_INDEX( ( SUBSTRING_INDEX( ( SUBSTRING_INDEX( referer, "://", -1 ) ), "/", 1 ) ), ".", -5 ), "www.", "" ) AS referer, COUNT(*) AS counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE dt BETWEEN '{timestamp}' AND '{timestamp}' AND ((referer NOT LIKE '%{host}%') AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) GROUP BY REPLACE( SUBSTRING_INDEX( ( SUBSTRING_INDEX( ( SUBSTRING_INDEX( referer, "://", -1 ) ), "/", 1 ) ), ".", -5 ), "www.", "" ) ORDER BY counthits DESC, referer ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT username, COUNT(*) AS counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE dt BETWEEN '{timestamp}' AND '{timestamp}' AND ((username IS NOT NULL AND username <> '') AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) GROUP BY username ORDER BY counthits DESC, username ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT searchterms, COUNT(*) AS counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE dt BETWEEN '{timestamp}' AND '{timestamp}' AND ((searchterms <> "_" AND searchterms <> "" AND searchterms IS NOT NULL) AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) GROUP BY searchterms ORDER BY counthits DESC, searchterms ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE dt BETWEEN '{timestamp}' AND '{timestamp}' AND ((1=1) AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) GROUP BY country ORDER BY counthits DESC, country ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT username, COUNT(*) AS counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE (((dt_out > {timestamp}) OR (dt > {timestamp})) AND username <> "" AND username IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY username ORDER BY counthits DESC, username ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) AS dt, MIN(dt) AS sort_dt, COUNT( searchterms ) AS v1, COUNT( DISTINCT searchterms ) AS v2, CASE WHEN dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp} THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END AS period FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE (((dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) OR (dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}))) AND ((searchterms <> "_" AND searchterms IS NOT NULL AND searchterms <> "")) GROUP BY period, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) WITH ROLLUP

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) AS dt, MIN(dt) AS sort_dt, COUNT( DISTINCT visit_id ) AS v1, COUNT( DISTINCT ip ) AS v2, CASE WHEN dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp} THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END AS period FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE (((dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) OR (dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}))) AND (((visit_id > 0 AND browser_type <> 1))) GROUP BY period, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) WITH ROLLUP

SELECT COUNT(*) as counthits FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE visit_id <> 0 AND ((visit_id > 0 AND browser_type <> 1) AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) GROUP BY visit_id HAVING GREATEST( MAX( dt ), MAX( dt_out ) ) - MIN( dt ) > 30 AND GREATEST( MAX( dt ), MAX( dt_out ) ) - MIN( dt ) <= 60 ) AS ts1

SELECT COUNT(*) as counthits FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE visit_id <> 0 AND ((visit_id > 0 AND browser_type <> 1) AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) GROUP BY visit_id HAVING GREATEST( MAX( dt ), MAX( dt_out ) ) - MIN( dt ) > 180 AND GREATEST( MAX( dt ), MAX( dt_out ) ) - MIN( dt ) <= 300 ) AS ts1

SELECT COUNT(*) as counthits FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE visit_id <> 0 AND ((visit_id > 0 AND browser_type <> 1) AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) GROUP BY visit_id HAVING GREATEST( MAX( dt ), MAX( dt_out ) ) - MIN( dt ) > 300 AND GREATEST( MAX( dt ), MAX( dt_out ) ) - MIN( dt ) <= 420 ) AS ts1

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), INTERVAL ((DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00')) - 1 - 1 + 7) % 7) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')) AS dt, MIN(dt) AS sort_dt, COUNT( DISTINCT visit_id ) AS v1, COUNT( DISTINCT ip ) AS v2, CASE WHEN dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp} THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END AS period FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE (((dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) OR (dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}))) AND (((visit_id > 0 AND browser_type <> 1))) GROUP BY period, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), INTERVAL ((DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00')) - 1 - 1 + 7) % 7) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')) WITH ROLLUP

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), INTERVAL ((DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00')) - 1 - 1 + 7) % 7) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')) AS dt, MIN(dt) AS sort_dt, COUNT( username ) AS v1, COUNT( DISTINCT username ) AS v2, CASE WHEN dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp} THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END AS period FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE (((dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) OR (dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}))) GROUP BY period, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), INTERVAL ((DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00')) - 1 - 1 + 7) % 7) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')) WITH ROLLUP

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), INTERVAL ((DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00')) - 1 - 1 + 7) % 7) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')) AS dt, MIN(dt) AS sort_dt, COUNT( DISTINCT referer ) AS v1, COUNT( DISTINCT ip ) AS v2, CASE WHEN dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp} THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END AS period FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE (((dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) OR (dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}))) AND (((referer IS NOT NULL AND referer NOT LIKE "%{home}%"))) GROUP BY period, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), INTERVAL ((DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00')) - 1 - 1 + 7) % 7) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')) WITH ROLLUP

SELECT COUNT(id) as counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE dt BETWEEN '{timestamp}' AND '{timestamp}' AND (((resource LIKE '%/feed%' OR resource LIKE '%?feed=>%' OR resource LIKE '%&feed=>%' OR content_type LIKE '%feed%')) AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp})

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), INTERVAL ((DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00')) - 1 - 1 + 7) % 7) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')) AS dt, MIN(dt) AS sort_dt, COUNT( outbound_resource ) AS v1, COUNT( DISTINCT outbound_resource ) AS v2, CASE WHEN dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp} THEN 'current' ELSE 'previous' END AS period FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE (((dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) OR (dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}))) GROUP BY period, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00'), INTERVAL ((DAYOFWEEK(CONVERT_TZ(FROM_UNIXTIME(dt), '+00:00', '-00:00')) - 1 - 1 + 7) % 7) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')) WITH ROLLUP

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT visit_id, MAX( CASE WHEN dt_out IS NOT NULL AND dt_out > 0 AND dt_out >= dt THEN dt_out ELSE dt END ) AS last_activity FROM (SELECT visit_id, dt, dt_out FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE ((1=1) AND (browser_type IS NULL OR browser_type <> 1)) AND visit_id > 0 AND dt >= {timestamp} UNION ALL SELECT visit_id, dt, dt_out FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE ((1=1) AND (browser_type IS NULL OR browser_type <> 1)) AND visit_id > 0 AND dt < {timestamp} AND dt_out >= {timestamp}) recent_activity GROUP BY visit_id HAVING (FLOOR(last_activity / 60) * 60 + 59) >= {timestamp} ) live_sessions

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(resource,'')) AS pages_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN country REGEXP '^[a-zA-Z]{2}$' AND LOWER(country) <> 'xx' THEN LOWER(country) END) AS countries_count FROM (SELECT resource, country FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE ((1=1) AND (browser_type IS NULL OR browser_type <> 1)) AND visit_id > 0 AND dt >= {timestamp} UNION ALL SELECT resource, country FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE ((1=1) AND (browser_type IS NULL OR browser_type <> 1)) AND visit_id > 0 AND dt < {timestamp} AND dt_out >= {timestamp}) live_pages
SELECT username, COUNT(*) AS pageviews FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE username IS NOT NULL AND ((1=1) AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp}) GROUP BY username
SELECT username, MAX(dt) AS last_login_dt FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE notes LIKE '%loggedin:%' AND username IS NOT NULL GROUP BY username

SELECT username, SUM(visit_duration) AS visit_duration FROM ( SELECT username, visit_id, MAX( GREATEST( dt, dt_out ) ) - MIN(dt) AS visit_duration FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE username IS NOT NULL AND visit_id > 0 AND (1=1) AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp} GROUP BY username, visit_id HAVING visit_duration > 0 ) AS per_visit GROUP BY username

SELECT id, ip, dt, username, referer, resource, browser, platform, country, city, content_type, notes, visit_id, server_latency, page_performance, browser_version, browser_type, language, fingerprint, user_agent, resolution, screen_width, screen_height, category, author, content_id, outbound_resource, tz_offset, dt_out FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE dt BETWEEN '{timestamp}' AND '{timestamp}' AND (username IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY username ASC, dt DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT traffic_channel, traffic_source, COUNT(*) AS counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE dt BETWEEN '{timestamp}' AND '{timestamp}' AND (1=1) AND ((traffic_channel = 'direct' OR traffic_channel = 'internal' OR traffic_channel IS NULL)) GROUP BY traffic_channel, traffic_source ORDER BY counthits DESC, traffic_channel, traffic_source LIMIT 200

SELECT m.minute_ts AS minute_timestamp, COUNT(DISTINCT s.visit_id) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT {timestamp} + (n.n * 60) AS minute_ts FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 6 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 7 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 8 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 9 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 10 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 11 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 12 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 13 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 14 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 15 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 16 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 17 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 18 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 19 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 20 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 21 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 22 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 23 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 24 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 25 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 26 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 27 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 28 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 29 AS n ) n ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT visit_id, FLOOR( MIN(dt) / 60 ) * 60 AS first_minute, FLOOR( MAX( CASE WHEN dt_out IS NOT NULL AND dt_out > 0 AND dt_out >= dt THEN dt_out ELSE dt END ) / 60 ) * 60 AS last_minute FROM (SELECT visit_id, dt, dt_out FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE ((1=1) AND (browser_type IS NULL OR browser_type <> 1)) AND visit_id > 0 AND dt >= {timestamp} UNION ALL SELECT visit_id, dt, dt_out FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE ((1=1) AND (browser_type IS NULL OR browser_type <> 1)) AND visit_id > 0 AND dt < {timestamp} AND dt_out >= {timestamp}) recent_activity WHERE dt <= {timestamp} GROUP BY visit_id HAVING last_minute >= {timestamp} ) s ON s.first_minute <= ( m.minute_ts + 59 ) AND s.last_minute >= m.minute_ts GROUP BY m.minute_ts ORDER BY m.minute_ts ASC
SELECT username, COUNT(*) as counthits FROM {prefix}slim_stats WHERE notes LIKE '%loggedin:%' AND dt BETWEEN {timestamp} AND {timestamp} AND username IS NOT NULL GROUP BY username
